source: DHM Islamic Studies Level 1 · lesson 24. Exercises reused from the lesson; du'aas flagged for review.
topic: Istinjaa: purification, du'aas and good manners

learn.en: Istinjaa means purification: cleaning yourself properly with water after using the toilet.
learn.title: Istinjaa

learn.en: Don't take anything with Allah's name into the toilet. Step in with your left foot and say the du'aa.
learn.title: Going in
learn.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الخُبُثِ وَالخَبَائِثِ
learn.tr: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika mina l-khubuthi wa l-khabāʾith

learn.en: Close the door. Don't talk inside. If you sneeze, praise Allah in your heart, not out loud.
learn.title: Inside

learn.en: Clean yourself well with water, then step out with your right foot and say: Ghufranak.
learn.title: Coming out

words.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الخُبُثِ وَالخَبَائِثِ
words.en: Entering: O Allah, I seek Your protection from the devils
words.tr: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika mina l-khubuthi wa l-khabāʾith

quiz.en: Step into the toilet with your ___ foot.
True or false? Do not say Alhamdulillah loudly while using the toilet.
True or false? I must not carry anything with Allah's name into the toilet.
True or false? It's good to talk and chat while using the toilet.

think.q: Can you remember the du'aa for entering the toilet? Practise it before you go tonight.
think.a: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika mina l-khubuthi wa l-khabāʾith.

parents.summary: Toilet manners: du'aa before entering (left foot), quiet inside, cleaning with water, right foot out saying Ghufrānak.
parents.tip: Stick a small reminder of the two du'aas near the bathroom door.
